name: Marked for Death
displayText: Target friendly Unit gains +3 ATK this turn. When it is defeated this turn, create two Thrall Tokens.

effectExplanations: You choose the Unit once. The delayed half watches that same Unit — it is never re-targeted.
notes: The watch lasts only for this turn. If the Unit survives to the end of the turn, nothing happens.
It watches that specific Unit while it is on the battlefield. A Unit that leaves the battlefield some other way — bounced to a hand, or removed from the game — takes the watch with it.
